subject: Data Engineering
title: Managed Databases in the Cloud
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Managed Databases in the Cloud.

hook.text: Running PostgreSQL on-prem means patching, backups, and 3 AM alerts. Cloud-managed? Just connect and query.

buildup.text: Managed databases handle patching, backups, replication, and failover automatically.

discovery.text: AWS RDS, Cloud SQL, and Azure SQL Database offer managed versions of popular open-source and commercial engines.

twist.text: Managed doesn't mean worry-free. You still own schema design, query optimization, and access control.

climax.text: Managed databases free data engineers from operations work so they can focus on data modeling and pipelines.

punchline.text: Let the cloud handle the plumbing. You handle the data.

quiz.question: What do managed cloud databases handle automatically?
